notes: Written by python -m wenart.assets.objaverse write-catalog on the prep pod (docs/milestone7.md §7); the integrator copies it into wenart/furniture/ before the full runs.
Boxes are metres in the Z-up frame of Blender's glTF importer: the raw GLB box times unit_scale (the §7.2 unit guess). The scene builder scales the imported mesh by unit_scale before fit_scale.
front_axis: the side both judges named on the 2 x 2 sheet, equal to the geometric check (front_axis_note); front-less types keep -Y with front_axis_confidence low.
styles: the intersection of both judges' answers (neutral only when both name it).
Per-object licences are uploader-declared and unverified: flag them before commercial use.
